fusions.name: Snare Lines
fusions.desc: Whips snaring strands at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage, stripping 10% armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 20%, then stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Draw the Noose
fusions.desc: Tightens a strand on a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leave it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Strand Listening
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Braided Garrotte
fusions.desc: Conjures a braided garrotte. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
